processing.originals: Unchanged. Six unedited selections exported with orientation applied and metadata stripped. HEIC edit inputs decoded locally using FFmpeg.
processing.enhancements: Five separate edits using the built-in image generation/editing tool, then WebP exports. Prompts requested natural color and clarity only, preserving composition, people, architecture, signs and objects. Generated photo edits may differ in fine details; originals remain available.
processing.prompt: Edit this exact original travel photo only for subtle natural color correction and clarity. Gently lift shadows and improve clarity, retaining the original daylight, nighttime or blue-hour atmosphere. Preserve full composition, aspect ratio, architecture, every person, all signs and text, decorations and objects. No added or removed details, reconstruction, replacement, stylization, fake HDR or cropping. For the portrait, preserve exact identity, expression, skin texture, hands, marshmallow, camera and gimbal.
